blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used to interpret religious, educational, and culturally sensitive visual content, yet their reliability on citation verification remains underexplored. We introduce Visual Sanad, a controlled benchmark for testing whether VLMs falsely accept incorrect Qur'anic verse attributions when the same quote-reference pair is rendered under different visual framings. The benchmark contains 2,400 rendered images built from 100 English Qur'an verses, four factual states per verse, and six visual conditions ranging from plain text to decorative and authority-framed layouts. All quote-reference pairs were source-checked and human-audited before rendering. Across 24 full model-prompt runs, we observe a sharp capability split. Proprietary API-served VLMs range from near-perfect citation verification to moderate false acceptance, whereas recent open-weight VLMs often show weak discrimination and default to VALID on most images. De-biased prompting can reduce false acceptance, but often by shifting the decision threshold toward INVALID rather than by producing strong citation discrimination. Visual Sanad therefore exposes a culturally grounded multimodal factuality failure: fluent VLMs may treat displayed religious citations as self-authenticating unless they have strong citation-verification ability.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用于解释宗教,教育和文化上敏感的视觉内容,然而它们在引用核查方面的可靠性仍然没有得到充分利用. 我们引入了Visual Sanad, 一个用于测试VLMs是否错误地接受错误的Qur'anic诗句归属的可控基准, 当同一引文参考对在不同的视觉框架下得到. 该基准包含从100个英文《古兰经》诗句、每节四个事实状态以及从纯正文字到装饰和权威框架布局等6个视觉条件所制作的2 400个图像。 所有引文参考对子在渲染前都经过了源头检查和人为审计. 整个24个模型瞬间,我们观察到一个尖锐的能力分裂。 专有的API服务VLM从近乎完美的引用验证到中度的虚假接受,而近期的开量VLM在大多数图像上往往表现出微弱的歧视和默认为VALID. 消除偏见的鼓励可以减少虚假的接受,但往往是通过将决定门槛转移到INVALID,而不是产生强烈的引用歧视。 因此,Visual Sanad揭露了一种基于文化的多模式事实上的失败:流利的VLM可能会将所显示的宗教引用视为自我认证,除非他们具有强大的引用核查能力。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Religious texts are often encountered through images: posters, screenshots, lecture slides, social media cards, and educational graphics.
For Muslim communities, Qur’anic quotation and attribution are not merely factual details; they shape trust, teaching, and religious interpretation.
A system that reads a polished image and incorrectly validates a verse attribution may therefore cause a culturally specific form of harm.
blocks.zh:
宗教文本经常通过图片出现:海报、截图、讲座幻灯片、社交媒体卡片和教育图形。
对穆斯林社区来说,《古兰经》的引言和归属不仅仅是事实细节;它们塑造了信任、教义和宗教解释。
因此,读取经磨损的图像和不正确地验证诗句归属的系统可能会造成一种文化上特有的伤害。

blocks.en:
This paper studies a narrow but important question: when an image contains an English Qur’an quote and a displayed surah:ayah reference, can modern VLMs verify whether the attribution is correct?
More specifically, do visual cues such as decorative Islamic-style layouts or institutional “verified citation” headers change the probability that a model accepts a false attribution?
This question sits at the intersection of rapid progress in VLMs ( Radford et al., 2021 ; Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; OpenAI, 2023 ) and growing evidence that multimodal systems can hallucinate or over-trust misleading inputs ( Li et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2024 ) .
Unlike object-hallucination benchmarks, Visual Sanad tests a fine-grained attribution decision in a culturally grounded religious setting, aligning with MusiML’s emphasis on AI systems relevant to Muslim communities ( Muslims in ML, 2026 ) .
Prior Islamic NLP benchmarks study Qur’anic question answering and broader Islamic knowledge evaluation ( Malhas et al., 2023 ; Abdelaal et al., 2026 ) ; Visual Sanad instead asks whether a VLM can verify a displayed quote–reference attribution in an image.
blocks.zh:
这篇论文研究了一个狭义但重要的问题:当一个图像包含一个英语的《古兰经》引文和一个显示的 surah:ayah 引用时,现代的VLMs能否验证归属是否正确?
更具体地说,诸如装饰性的伊斯兰风格布局或体制性的“核实引用”标题等视觉提示是否改变模型接受虚假归属的可能性?
这个问题位于VLMs快速进展的交汇点(Radford等人,2021年;Alayrac等人,2022年;Liu等人,2023年;OpenAI,2023年)和越来越多的证据表明,多式联运系统可能会产生幻觉或过度信任的误导性投入(Li等人,2023年;Bai等人,2024年)。
Visual Sanad在基于文化的宗教环境中测试一个精细的归属决定,
以前的伊斯兰NLP基准研究 " 古兰经问题回答 " 和更广泛的伊斯兰知识评价(Malhas等人,2023年;Abdelaal等人,2026年);视觉 Sanad则询问VLM是否能够在图像中验证一个显示的引文 - 引用属性 。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • a controlled 2,400-image benchmark for Qur’anic citation verification under six visual conditions; • a human-audited construction pipeline using valid references and three invalid foil types; • baseline evaluations of four closed VLMs and eight open VLMs under natural and de-biased prompts; and • paired analyses measuring visual framing effects and prompt-debiasing effects on the same underlying invalid items.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:在6个视觉条件下对《古兰经》引文进行控制下的2 400个图像核查基准;使用有效参照和3种无效型的人工审计建筑管道;在自然和非偏见的提示下对4个封闭的VLM和8个开放的VLM进行基线评价;以及进行组合分析,以衡量视觉框架效应和对同一基本无效物品的迅速减速效应。

blocks.en: a controlled 2,400-image benchmark for Qur’anic citation verification under six visual conditions;
blocks.zh: a. 在6个视觉条件下对Quar ' anic引用进行核查的可控2 400图像基准;

blocks.en: a human-audited construction pipeline using valid references and three invalid foil types;
blocks.zh: 使用有效参考物和三种无效钢管的经人审计的建筑管道;

blocks.en: baseline evaluations of four closed VLMs and eight open VLMs under natural and de-biased prompts; and
blocks.zh: 在自然和无偏见的提示下,对4个封闭的VLM和8个开放的VLM进行基线评价;以及

blocks.en: paired analyses measuring visual framing effects and prompt-debiasing effects on the same underlying invalid items.
blocks.zh: 组合分析,测量视觉框架效应和对同一基本无效物品的迅速减值效应。

blocks.en:
Our central finding is not that visual authority cues overwhelm every model.
Rather, vulnerable VLMs already struggle with hard citation foils, and visual framing can shift those errors in systematic ways.
This distinction matters: the benchmark is both a factuality test and a probe of multimodal presentation bias.
blocks.zh:
我们的发现不是视觉权威 压倒每个模型。
相反,易受伤害的VLM已经与硬引号相搏,视觉框架可以系统地改变这些错误。
这一区别很重要:基准既是对事实的检验,也是对多式联运表述偏差的探索。

blocks.en: 2 Dataset: Visual Sanad
blocks.zh: 2 数据集:视觉萨纳德

blocks.en:
We use the AlQuran Cloud en.sahih edition as the source for English verse text and references ( Islamic Network, 2026 ) .
Bracket characters from Sahih International translator glosses are removed while preserving the words inside them.
Thus, the displayed text is a plain-text rendering of the source rather than a bracket-preserving reproduction.
blocks.zh:
我们使用《古兰经》云(Al Quarran Cloud en.sahih)版作为英文诗文和参考资料的来源(伊斯兰网,2026年)。
来自Sahih International翻译器的bracket字符在保留其中的单词的同时被删除.
因此,所显示的文本是来源的纯文本渲染,而不是保留括号的复制.

blocks.en:
We select 100 base verses after filtering for readability and duplicate safety.
Each base verse is paired with four factual states: 1. Valid : the displayed reference is the true reference. 2. Near-neighbor : the displayed reference is a nearby ayah in the same surah. 3. Same-surah far : the displayed reference is a farther ayah in the same surah. 4. Cross-surah lexical : the displayed reference is from another surah with lexical overlap. Invalid foils are screened with exact, character-level, and asymmetric token-containment checks to avoid cases where the target quote is effectively embedded in the foil.
blocks.zh:
我们在过滤可读性和重复安全性之后,选择100个基本符号。
每节基本诗句与四个事实状态成对: 1. 有效性:显示的参考物是真实的参考物。 2. 近邻:所显示的参考文献是同一区附近的ayah。 3. Same-surah far : 显示的参考文献在同一 surah 中更远。 4. Cross-surah lexical : 所显示的参考文献来自另一个有 lexical重叠的 surah 。 无效的螺旋盖通过精确,字符级,不对称的符节封存检查进行筛选,以避免目标引文有效嵌入螺旋盖内的情况.

blocks.en: Valid : the displayed reference is the true reference.
blocks.zh: 有效 : 显示的引用是真实的引用 。

blocks.en: Near-neighbor : the displayed reference is a nearby ayah in the same surah.
blocks.zh: 近邻:显示的参考文献是同一 surah 中的一个附近的ayah.

blocks.en: Same-surah far : the displayed reference is a farther ayah in the same surah.
blocks.zh: 显示的参考文献更进一步。

blocks.en: Cross-surah lexical : the displayed reference is from another surah with lexical overlap.
blocks.zh: Cross-surah lexical : 所显示的参考文献来自另一个有 lexical 重叠的 surah 。

blocks.en:
Each quote–reference pair is rendered under six image conditions: plain , decorative , islamic_authority , decorative_islamic_authority , neutral_authority , and decorative_neutral_authority .
Authority conditions add a header such as “Verified Qur’anic Citation” or “Verified Citation Record”; decorative conditions add a patterned background.
The final dataset has 100 × 4 × 6 = 2,400 100\times 4\times 6=2{,}400 images.
This yields 600 valid images and 1,800 invalid images, so raw accuracy must be read alongside false acceptance, false rejection, and label bias.
blocks.zh:
每个引文 - 参考对在六个图像条件下给出: 平坦 , 装饰性 , Islamic_authority , 装饰性_islamic_authority , 中性_authority 和 装饰性_中性_authority 。
权威条件增加了一个标题,如 " 核证的古兰经引用 " 或 " 核证的引用记录 " ;装饰条件增加了一个图案背景。
最终数据集为100×4×6=2400100×4 6=2{,}400张图像.
这会产生600个有效图像和1800个无效图像,因此原始准确度必须与虚假接受,虚假拒绝,以及标签偏差同时读取.

blocks.en:
The dataset was audited in three passes before locking.
Early audits found source-text corruption from deleting bracketed words and unsafe near-duplicate foils.
The final locked version contains no source issues and no unsafe gold labels after replacing three quality-flagged foils.
Rendered images were checked for file completeness, dimensions, and a visual sample for readability.
blocks.zh:
数据集在锁定前经过三次审核.
早期的审计发现删除括号内的文字和不安全的近似重复的废纸有源文字腐败。
最终锁定的版本在替换三个质量标记的螺旋桨后没有源头问题,也没有不安全的金色标签.
对制作的图像进行了文件完整性、尺寸和可读性的视觉样本检查。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
Models receive one rendered image and must return VALID , INVALID , or ABSTAIN .
The main metric is false-accept rate on invalid trials: the percentage of invalid quote–reference pairs labeled VALID .
We also report false-reject rate on valid trials and discrimination, computed as 100 − false ​ accept − false ​ reject 100-\mathrm{false\ accept}-\mathrm{false\ reject} ; a constant VALID model scores near 25% raw accuracy but near-zero discrimination.
Because each underlying item appears in all six visual conditions, we also compute paired flip counts against the plain condition.
blocks.zh:
模型接收一个成像,必须返回VALID、INVALID或ABSTAIN。
主要衡量标准是无效试验上的虚假接受率:无效引文的百分比–参考对标签为VALID.
我们还报告关于有效审判和歧视的虚假拒绝率,计算为100 - 虚假接受 - 虚假拒绝 100 - mathrm{ false\ accept} -\mathrm{ false\ 拒绝};一个恒定VALID模型得分接近25%的原始准确度,但几乎为零。
由于每个基本项目都出现在所有六个视觉条件中, 我们也计算成对的翻转计数 与普通条件。

blocks.en:
We use two prompts.
The natural prompt asks the model to decide whether the displayed quote belongs to the displayed reference.
The de-biased prompt adds one cautionary instruction: “Do not treat decorative design, religious-looking borders, or verification headers as evidence that the citation is correct.”
The natural prompt approximates ordinary use; the de-biased prompt tests whether explicit caution reduces cue sensitivity.
blocks.zh:
我们使用两个提示。
自然提示要求模型决定显示的引文是否属于显示的引用.
消除偏见的提示增加了一项告诫性指示:“不要将装饰设计、宗教外观边界或核查头当作引用正确的证据。 “
自然的即时性大约是一般使用;去偏见的即时性测试是否明确谨慎会降低提示灵敏度.

blocks.en:
We evaluate GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.6-Terra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Qwen2.5-VL-7B/32B ( Bai et al., 2025b ) , Qwen3-VL-8B/32B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) , InternVL3.5-8B/38B ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , MiniCPM-V 4.5 ( Yu et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma 4 12B-IT ( Gemma Team, 2026 ) .
Each completed model–prompt pair is run over all 2,400 images.
Open-source runs use greedy deterministic decoding with do_sample=False and fixed seed 31.
Empty or unparsed API responses are retried and merged into clean result files; all main runs reported below contain no errors and no unparsed labels.
blocks.zh:
我们评价GPT-4o、GPT-4.1、GPT-5.5、GPT-5.6-Terra。 (OpenAI, 2026) (中文(简体) ). Quen2.5-VL-7B/32B (Bai等人,2025年b), Quen3-VL-8B/32B(Bai等人,2025年a), InternVL3.5-8B/38B (Wang等人,2025年),MiniCPM-V 4.5(Yu等人,2025年),Gemma 4 12B-IT(Gemma Team,2026年).
每个完成的模型 - 即时对齐运行在所有2400张图像上.
开源运行使用贪婪的定型解码,其中 do_sample=False和固定种子31.
空或未解析的 API 响应被重试并合并为干净的结果文件;下面报告的所有主要运行都包含没有错误和未解析的标签.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en:
Table 1 summarizes the main model comparison; Figure 1 visualizes natural-prompt false acceptance and prompt sensitivity.
False accept is computed over 1,800 invalid images per run, pooling near-neighbor, same-surah-far, and cross-surah lexical foils; Appendix Table 3 breaks this down by foil type.
Closed models show a large capability gradient: GPT-4o and GPT-4.1 have substantial false acceptance, GPT-5.6-Terra improves sharply, and GPT-5.5 is nearly saturated.
Open models show a different failure mode: several produce clean labels while saying VALID on 90–99% of images, yielding near-zero discrimination despite near-perfect displayed-reference reading.
blocks.zh:
表1总结了主要的模型比较;图1可视化自然即时的假接受和即时的灵敏度.
假收值计算为每跑1 800多幅无效图像,汇集了近邻、同远和跨远的字形胶片;附录表3按胶片类型细分。
闭合模型显示大容量梯度:GPT-4o和GPT-4.1具有实质性的虚假接受,GPT-5.6-Terra大幅改进,GPT-5.5几乎饱和.
开放模型显示不同的失败模式:在90—99%的图像上说VALID时,有几个厂家会生产干净的标签,尽管几乎是完美的显示参考读数,却导致近乎零的歧视。

blocks.en: Table 1: Overall invalid-citation false acceptance, discrimination, and response bias on the locked 2,400-image dataset. Values are percentages. Discrimination is 100 − false ​ accept − false ​ reject 100-\mathrm{false\ accept}-\mathrm{false\ reject} , so higher is better; false accept is lower better. Says VALID is diagnostic and has no preferred direction.
blocks.zh: 表1:锁定的2,400个图像数据集中的总体无效引用错误接受、歧视和反应偏差。 数值为百分比。 歧视为100 – 虚假接受 – 虚假拒绝为100\ mathrm{ false\ 接受为} -\ mathrm{ false\ 拒绝为} , 所以更高更好; 虚假接受为更好。 说VALID是诊断性的,没有偏好的方向.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Invalid-citation false acceptance. (a) Natural-prompt failures show a sharp closed/open split. (b) De-biased prompting reduces false acceptance for some models but does not replace verification.
blocks.zh: 图1:无效引用的虚假接受。 (a) 自然瞬间发生的故障显示密闭/开放式的分化。 (b) 消除偏见的促使减少对某些型号的虚假接受,但不取代核查。

blocks.en:
Visual framing effects are smaller than the model-capability effect, but they are not negligible.
For GPT-4o under the natural prompt, false acceptance is 13.00% on plain invalid images and rises to 17.33% for decorative neutral-authority images.
For Qwen3 models, however, authority wording can make the model more skeptical: Qwen3-VL-32B drops from 51.33% on plain images to 34.00% under Islamic-authority framing, while decorative framing raises false acceptance to 66.33%.
For InternVL3.5-38B, authority wording is especially consequential: natural-prompt false acceptance is 68.67% on plain invalid images but 89.33% under both Islamic-authority and neutral-authority headers.
For MiniCPM-V 4.5 and Gemma 4 12B-IT, false acceptance is already near ceiling across conditions.
Appendix Figure 3 and Table 4 show the full condition-wise breakdown.
blocks.zh:
视觉框架效应比模型能力效应小,但不可忽略。
对于自然速率下的GPT-4o,在纯无效图像上误收率为13.00%,而装饰性中性授权图像则上升至17.33%.
然而,对于Qune3模型,权威措辞可以让模型更加怀疑:Qune3-VL-32B在伊斯兰权威框架下从平面图像上的51.33%下降到34.00%,而装饰性框架则将虚假接受率提升到66.33%.
对InternVL3.5-38B来说,权威措辞尤其明显:在简单无效的图像中,自然即时接受率为68.67%,而在伊斯兰权威和中立权威标题中,接受率为89.33%。
对于MiniCPM-V 4.5和Gemma 4 12B-IT,不同条件的虚假接收已经接近上限。
附录图3和表4按具体情况列出全部细目。

blocks.en:
The de-biased instruction reduces false acceptance for several models under paired McNemar tests ( McNemar, 1947 ) on invalid items, but Table 1 shows why this is not the same as solving citation verification.
For example, Qwen3-VL-32B’s de-biased false-accept rate improves from 52.17% to 43.17%, while discrimination falls from 12.16 to 10.83 because false rejection increases.
Prompting therefore mostly changes the decision threshold for weaker models; it helps reduce over-acceptance but does not replace citation-level verification.
blocks.zh:
脱偏见指令减少了对无效项目进行配对的麦克内马尔测试(McNemar,1947年)下的若干型号的虚假接受,但表1显示了为什么这与解析引用验证不同.
例如,Qwen3-VL-32B的去偏见虚假接受率从52.17%上升到43.17%,而歧视则从12.16下降到10.83,因为虚假拒绝率上升。
因此,催化主要改变较弱模型的决定门槛;它有助于减少过度接受,但不会取代引用一级的核查。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Visual Sanad supports a concrete claim: multimodal citation verification in Islamic contexts remains nontrivial for several widely used VLMs.
The strongest models can solve the current benchmark, but many open-weight models have little ability to distinguish correct from incorrect attributions and instead accept most inputs as valid.
Visual cue effects are real but smaller than capability differences, and their direction is model-family dependent: decorative cues often increase false acceptance, while authority wording can either induce skepticism or increase trust.
blocks.zh:
Visual Sanad支持一项具体主张:伊斯兰背景下的多式联运引用核查对于一些广泛使用的VLM来说仍然是非三角的.
最强的模型可以解决当前的基准,但许多开放量模型几乎没有能力区分正确和不正确的归属,而是接受大多数输入是有效的.
视觉提示效应是真实的,但比能力差异小,其方向是模型-家族依赖性:装饰提示往往会增加虚假接受,而权威措辞则可能诱发怀疑或增加信任.

blocks.en:
The study has limitations:
First, the benchmark uses English translations, not Arabic Qur’anic text.
Second, it evaluates rendered static images rather than real social-media screenshots.
Third, although we include several larger open VLMs, the set is still not exhaustive and fast-moving model releases may change the frontier.
Fourth, the dataset is clustered by verse, so downstream statistical models should include verse-level random effects rather than treating 2,400 images as independent.
blocks.zh:
这项研究有以下局限性:
首先,基准使用英文翻译,而不是阿拉伯文《古兰经》文本。
其次,它的评价是制作静态图像,而不是真正的社交媒体截图。
第三,虽然我们包括了几个更大的开放的VLM,但该套集仍然不是详尽无遗的,快速移动的模型释放可能会改变边际。
第四,数据集由诗句组合而成,因此下游统计模型应当包括诗句级随机效应,而不是将2400张图像视为独立.

blocks.en:
For deployment, the main lesson is that citation verification should not be treated as a generic visual question-answering capability.
Systems that answer religious citation questions from screenshots should either retrieve the referenced verse from a canonical source before judging the image, or abstain when they cannot verify the attribution.
Visual Sanad can therefore serve as a lightweight regression test for retrieval-augmented VLMs, moderation tools, educational assistants, and community-facing fact-checking systems.
blocks.zh:
就部署而言,主要经验教训是,引用核查不应被视为通用视觉问答能力。
从截图中解答宗教引用问题的系统在判断图像之前,应当从犬科来源取回引用的诗句,或在无法核实归属时弃权。
因此,Visual Sanad可以作为检索增强的VLM、节制工具、教育助理和社区事实检查系统的轻量级回归测试。

blocks.en:
The failure mode matters because religious citations often circulate as images in messaging apps, lecture slides, posters, and social media, where a model that confidently validates an incorrect attribution may amplify rather than correct misinformation.
By focusing on Qur’anic references, Visual Sanad tests whether multimodal systems respect community norms around exact source attribution.
blocks.zh:
失败模式很重要,因为宗教引用常常作为图片在信息应用、讲座幻灯片、海报和社交媒体中流传,一个自信地验证错误归属的模式可能会扩大而不是纠正错误信息。
Visual Sanad通过关注Quar ' anic的参考文献,测试多式联运系统是否围绕确切的来源归属尊重社区规范。

blocks.en:
We retain the locked manifest, prompts, audit notes, inference outputs, and analysis scripts used for the reported results.
Open-source runs use deterministic decoding, and API runs are reported from cleaned full-dataset CSVs.
blocks.zh:
我们保留用于报告结果的锁定清单、提示、审计说明、推断产出和分析脚本。
开源运行使用定型解码,API运行报告来自清理后的全数据集CSV.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: Visual Sanad shows that Qur’anic citation verification in images is a culturally grounded test of multimodal factuality: strong models can solve it, while many open-weight VLMs show weak discrimination, high VALID bias, and model-dependent cue sensitivity.
blocks.zh: Visual Sanad 显示,图像中的Qur ' anic引用验证是对多模式事实性的基于文化的测试:强大的模型可以解决它,而许多开放量级的VLM则显示出薄弱的歧视,VALID的高度偏差,以及模型依赖的提示敏感性.

blocks.en: Appendix A Dataset construction details
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据集构建细节

blocks.en: Visual Sanad is constructed from 100 base verses in the AlQuran Cloud en.sahih edition. Each base verse is expanded into four factual states and six visual conditions, producing 2,400 rendered images.
blocks.zh: 《古兰经》的100个基本节文中, 每部基本诗集被扩展为四个事实状态和六个视觉条件,产生2400张制作的图像.

blocks.en: For every base verse, we create one valid item and three invalid foils: • Valid : the displayed quote and displayed reference match. • Near-neighbor : the reference points to a nearby ayah in the same surah. • Same-surah far : the reference points to a farther ayah in the same surah. • Cross-surah lexical : the reference points to another surah with lexical overlap.
blocks.zh: 对于每个碱性诗句,我们创建一个有效的项目和三个无效的阴茎: 有效:显示的引文和显示的引用匹配. • 近邻:指同一区的一个附近的ayah。 · 远近相同:参考指更远处同一区。 • 跨海岸语法:指另一个语法重叠的语法。

blocks.en: Valid : the displayed quote and displayed reference match.
blocks.zh: 有效 : 显示的引文和显示的引用匹配 。

blocks.en: Near-neighbor : the reference points to a nearby ayah in the same surah.
blocks.zh: 近邻:指近邻的一个亚亚,

blocks.en: Same-surah far : the reference points to a farther ayah in the same surah.
blocks.zh: 参考文献指出,

blocks.en: Cross-surah lexical : the reference points to another surah with lexical overlap.
blocks.zh: Cross-surah lexical : 参照点指另一个存在语法重叠的 surah.

blocks.en: Invalid candidates are filtered with exact-string checks, normalized character-overlap checks, and asymmetric token-containment checks. This prevents cases where the displayed quote is effectively contained in the foil verse, which would make an invalid label ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 无效的考生通过精确的字符串检查,正常的字符重叠检查,以及不对称的代号-约束检查过滤. 这样做可以防止显示的引文被有效包含在阴道诗文中的情况,这将使无效的标签变得模糊不清.

blocks.en: The six conditions are plain , decorative , islamic_authority , decorative_islamic_authority , neutral_authority , and decorative_neutral_authority . Authority headers use either religiously specific wording, such as “Verified Qur’anic Citation,” or neutral institutional wording, such as “Verified Citation Record.”
blocks.zh: 6个条件都是平坦的,装饰性的,islamic_authority的,装饰性的,islamic_authority的,中性的_authority的,和装饰性的_中性的_authority的. 当局标题要么使用宗教上的具体措辞,如 " 经核实的《古兰经》引文 " ,要么使用 " 经核实的引文记录 " 等中立的机构措辞。 “

blocks.en: Appendix B Audit summary
blocks.zh: 附录B 审计摘要

blocks.en: The final audit found no source-text corruption and no unsafe gold labels after corrective replacements. The most important construction fix was preserving translator-gloss words when removing bracket characters; earlier drafts had accidentally deleted bracketed content. The final locked dataset also removed or replaced three quality-flagged foils before rendering.
blocks.zh: 最后审计发现没有源文本腐败,在补正后没有不安全的金色标签. 最重要的构造修补是在删除括号字符时保留翻译- gloss字;早先的草案不慎删除了括号内的内容。 最终锁定的数据集也在渲染前移除或替换了三个带有质量标记的螺旋桨.

blocks.en: The prompt text below is line-wrapped for page layout.
blocks.zh: 下面的及时文本是用于页面布局的行包。

blocks.en: You are evaluating an image that displays an English Qur’an quote and a surah:ayah reference. Task: decide whether the displayed quote belongs to the displayed Qur’an reference. Return only a compact JSON object with exactly these keys: { "displayed_reference": "...", "label": "VALID" | "INVALID" | "ABSTAIN", "confidence": "low" | "medium" | "high" } Use VALID only if the displayed quote matches the displayed surah:ayah reference. Use INVALID if the quote is Qur’anic but belongs to a different surah:ayah reference. Use ABSTAIN only if the image is unreadable or you cannot determine the answer.
blocks.zh: 您正在评估一个显示英文《古兰经》引文和 surah:ayah 引用的图像。 任务: 决定显示的引用是否属于显示的《古兰经》引用 。 只返回带有这些密钥的紧凑 JSON 对象 : { 'displayed_Reference' : "...", "label" : "VALID" | "INVALID" | "ABSTER", "自信" : "低" | "中" | "高" } 仅在显示的引文与显示的 surah: ayah 引用匹配时使用 VALID 。 如果引用是Quar ' anic, 但属于不同的 surah:ayah 引用, 请使用 INVALID 。 仅在图像无法读取或无法确定答案时使用 ABSPAIN 。

blocks.en: The de-biased prompt uses the same text as above, followed by:
blocks.zh: 消除偏见的提示使用与上文相同的文字,然后:

blocks.en: Do not treat decorative design, religious-looking borders, or verification headers as evidence that the citation is correct.
blocks.zh: 不得将装饰设计,宗教外观边框,或核查头当作引用正确的证据.

blocks.en:
Table 2 reports all completed model–prompt runs used in the analysis.
Displayed-reference extraction was near ceiling in these runs: the model-reported reference matched the rendered reference in at least 99.83% of rows for every reported run, and most runs reached 100%.
Abstention was also rare, never exceeding 0.62% in any run; for example, MiniCPM-V 4.5 under the natural prompt produced high-confidence errors on 74.5% of all images while abstaining on none.

弃置率也很少,在任何运行中都从未超过0.62%;例如,MiniCPM-V 4.5在自然瞬间下,在所有图像的74.5%上都产生了高度的置信误差,但没有投弃权。

Net rescue is the difference between these two counts, while lower McNemar’s p p reports stronger evidence that the paired flips are asymmetric rather than random prompt noise.
